diagnosis.primary: The treatment plan for impacted teeth (K01.100) is 88 extraction.

source_handle: Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. 4% articaine block anesthesia, crown division, tensioning, extraction, alveolar socket reduction, and compression to stop bleeding.
